title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 1,651–1,700 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: The Pingxi Sky Lantern Festival is famous worldwide.
examples.zh: 平溪天燈節享譽全球。

examples.en: Our town hosts an annual mango jazz festival every July.
examples.zh: 我們小鎮每年七月都會舉辦一年一度的芒果爵士音樂節。

examples.en: Visitors from overseas enjoyed traditional dances during the harvest festival.
examples.zh: 來自海外的遊客在豐年祭慶典期間欣賞了精采的傳統舞蹈。

examples.en: National Day is a designated public holiday across the island.
examples.zh: 國慶日是全台灣法定的國定假日。

examples.en: We plan to spend our winter holiday hiking in Taitung.
examples.zh: 我們計畫在寒假期間前往台東登山健行。

examples.en: Bank branches and government offices are closed during the national holiday.
examples.zh: 銀行分行與政府機關在國定休假日期間均暫停營業。

examples.en: Giving red envelopes is a cherished Lunar New Year tradition.
examples.zh: 發紅包是農曆新年一項深具意義的珍貴傳統。

examples.en: It has long been a family tradition to eat breakfast together on Sundays.
examples.zh: 週日全家一起吃早餐長久以來都是我們家的家庭傳統慣例。

examples.en: Respecting teachers and masters is an essential cultural tradition in Asia.
examples.zh: 尊師重道是亞洲文化中不可或缺的優良文化傳統。

examples.en: Handcrafted Taiwanese tea sets showcase fine traditional art.
examples.zh: 純手工製作的台灣茶具展現了精緻的傳統工藝。

examples.en: Grandmother still cooks sticky rice following her traditional family recipe.
examples.zh: 外婆依然遵循她世代相傳的傳統家族食譜烹調香噴噴的油飯。

examples.en: You can see performers wearing colorful traditional costumes at the village parade.
examples.zh: 你可以在鄉村遊行隊伍中看見表演者身著色彩繽紛的傳統服飾。

examples.en: Eating round tangyuan during Dongzhi (Winter Solstice) is an ancient custom.
examples.zh: 冬至吃象徵圓滿的湯圓是一項古老的民俗。

examples.en: International travelers should respect local social customs when visiting temples.
examples.zh: 跨國旅行者在造訪寺廟宮觀時應當尊重當地的民俗習慣。

examples.en: Giving newlyweds pairs of chopsticks is an auspicious wedding custom.
examples.zh: 贈送成雙成對的筷子給新人是寓意早生貴子的吉祥婚俗。

examples.en: Night markets are an essential part of Taiwanese culinary culture.
examples.zh: 夜市是台灣飲食文化中不可或缺的重要一環。

examples.en: Reading foreign literature introduces you to unique ways of life and culture.
examples.zh: 閱讀外國文學作品能引領你認識獨特的生活型態與多元文化。

examples.en: Corporate culture at this tech firm emphasizes teamwork and open communication.
examples.zh: 這家科技公司的企業文化十分強調團隊協作與開放暢通的溝通。

examples.en: Tainan has a rich historical and cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 台南擁有豐富深厚的歷史與文化底蘊。

examples.en: Studying overseas helps students bridge delicate cultural differences with ease.
examples.zh: 赴海外留學有助於學生輕鬆跨越細微微妙的文化差異。

examples.en: The cultural center holds monthly exhibitions featuring contemporary local artists.
examples.zh: 文化中心每月都會舉辦展覽，展示當代本土藝術家的精彩傑作。

examples.en: The New Year countdown celebration at Taipei 101 drew a huge crowd.
examples.zh: 台北 101 的跨年倒數慶祝活動吸引了龐大人潮。

examples.en: We threw a joyous graduation celebration for our sister last Saturday night.
examples.zh: 上週六晚上我們為姐姐舉辦了一場充滿歡笑的畢業慶祝派對。

examples.en: Fireworks and street feasts were held in joyous celebration of the championship.
examples.zh: 為熱烈慶祝奪得冠軍，街頭施放了繽紛煙火並舉行了盛大慶功宴。

examples.en: Families gather happily together to celebrate the Moon Festival.
examples.zh: 各個家庭歡聚一堂共同慶祝中秋佳節。

examples.en: How do you and your best friends usually celebrate your birthdays?
examples.zh: 你和最要好的朋友們平時通常都如何歡度慶祝生日？

examples.en: Neighbors cheered and celebrated together when our team won the baseball finals.
examples.zh: 當我們球隊贏得棒球總決賽時，街坊鄰居齊聲歡呼並共同熱烈慶祝。

examples.en: The opening ceremony of the sports games was spectacular.
examples.zh: 運動會的開幕典禮場面十分壯觀隆重。

examples.en: Our high school graduation ceremony will be held in the main gymnasium tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們的高中畢業典禮將於明天在學校體育館主館隆重舉行。

examples.en: The traditional tea ceremony requires patience, calm posture, and precise focus.
examples.zh: 傳統茶道儀式講求沉著耐心、端正儀態以及高度專注的心境。

examples.en: Lunar New Year is the most important holiday for Taiwanese families.
examples.zh: 農曆新年是台灣家庭最重要的大節日。

examples.en: Millions travel south ahead of Lunar New Year to reunite with their parents.
examples.zh: 數百萬人在農曆春節前夕紛紛返鄉南下，與親愛的父母團聚。

examples.en: Red lanterns and spring couplets decorate front doors during Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 農曆春節期間，家家戶戶大門口都懸掛著大紅燈籠並貼上春聯。

examples.en: Elders give lucky red envelopes containing cash to children.
examples.zh: 長輩會向晚輩孩童發放裝有壓歲錢的喜氣紅包。

examples.en: Kids politely wish their grandparents good health before receiving a red envelope.
examples.zh: 小朋友們在領取紅包之前，都會禮貌地向祖父母拜年祝賀身體健康。

examples.en: Crisp, brand-new bank notes are preferred when preparing a festive red envelope.
examples.zh: 準備過年喜氣紅包時，通常偏好使用平整簇新的全新鈔票。

examples.en: Having reunion dinner on New Year's Eve warms every heart.
examples.zh: 在除夕夜圍爐吃團圓飯溫暖了每個人的心。

examples.en: Steaming hot pot and whole fish are traditional staples of the annual reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 冒著熱氣的美味火鍋與象徵年年有餘的整條鮮魚是年夜飯的經典要角。

examples.en: Even family members living abroad fly back home specifically for the reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 即使旅居海外的家庭成員，也會專程搭機返鄉共赴這場圍爐團圓年夜飯。

examples.en: Setting off loud firecrackers is believed to scare off evil spirits.
examples.zh: 燃放震耳欲聾的爆竹被認為能驅逐邪煞年獸。

examples.en: Strings of red firecrackers popped and sparked brightly outside the temple gate.
examples.zh: 一串串紅豔的鞭炮在宮廟大門前劈啪作響、金星四射。

examples.en: Many cities encourage digital audio recordings instead of real gunpowder firecrackers.
examples.zh: 許多都會城市鼓勵以電子鞭炮音效代替傳統實體火藥爆竹以策安全。

examples.en: The dazzling Taipei 101 fireworks display lit up the midnight sky.
examples.zh: 耀眼奪目的台北 101 跨年煙火秀點亮了午夜夜空。

examples.en: Crowds gathered along Tamsui River bank to watch the romantic summer fireworks.
examples.zh: 大批群眾聚集在淡水河岸邊，欣賞浪漫唯美的夏日大稻埕煙火秀。

examples.en: Brilliant colorful fireworks reflected across the calm water during National Day.
examples.zh: 國慶日璀璨絢爛的五彩煙火倒映在平靜澄澈的波光水面上。

examples.en: Lantern Festival marks the official climax and end of the New Year celebrations.
examples.zh: 元宵節標誌著整個農曆春節慶祝活動的高潮與尾聲。

examples.en: Eating sweet sesame tangyuan with family brings comfort on cold Lantern Festival nights.
examples.zh: 在微寒的元宵節夜晚與家人一起品嚐香甜芝麻湯圓令人備感暖心。

examples.en: The Taiwan Lantern Festival rotates between different host cities across the island each year.
examples.zh: 台灣燈會每年都會在全台不同主辦縣市輪流盛大登場。

examples.en: Children carry glowing animal-shaped paper lanterns in the park.
examples.zh: 小朋友們在公園裡提著發光的可愛生肖紙燈籠。

examples.en: Red cloth lanterns hung outside traditional courtyard homes create a cozy ambiance.
examples.zh: 三合院老宅門外懸掛的大紅布燈籠營造出溫馨懷舊的氛圍。

examples.en: In the past, night watchmen carried oil-lit lanterns to guide their patrol steps.
examples.zh: 在過去年代，巡夜更夫總是提著點燃油燈的小燈籠照亮巡邏夜路。

examples.en: Visitors write heartfelt wishes on paper sky lanterns and release them into the night sky.
examples.zh: 遊客將真摯願望寫在天燈上並讓其冉冉升空。

examples.en: Releasing a glowing sky lantern along the railway track in Pingxi is truly memorable.
examples.zh: 在平溪鐵道旁親手放飛一盞暖光天燈是一段極為難忘的美好體驗。

examples.en: Biodegradable eco sky lanterns are now being engineered to minimize forest litter.
examples.zh: 現在已研發出可自然生物分解的環保天燈，以將山林垃圾量降至最低。

examples.en: Solving clever riddles on Lantern Festival night is entertaining.
examples.zh: 在元宵節夜晚猜有趣的燈謎既益智又娛樂。

examples.en: The puzzle host gave contestants three subtle clues to solve the tricky riddle.
examples.zh: 猜謎活動主持人給了參賽選手三個巧妙提示來解開這道棘手的謎語。

examples.en: How the ancient builders moved those massive stone slabs remains an unsolved riddle.
examples.zh: 古代工匠究竟是如何搬運那些巨大石板的，至今仍是一個未解之謎。

examples.en: Families visit ancestral cemeteries on Tomb Sweeping Day to show filial respect.
examples.zh: 家人在清明節前往祖先墓園掃墓祭祖以表孝思。

examples.en: Eating freshly rolled spring rolls (runbing) is a classic Tomb Sweeping Day custom.
examples.zh: 品嚐現點現包的爽口潤餅是清明時節極具代表性的經典食俗。

examples.en: Expressways experience heavy northbound and southbound traffic during Tomb Sweeping Day.
examples.zh: 清明連假期間高速公路南下北上路段均會湧現龐大的車流量。

examples.en: We honor our ancestors by offering fresh fruit and flowers.
examples.zh: 我們藉由敬獻新鮮水果與花卉來緬懷祖先。

examples.en: Her ancestors migrated across the strait to Tainan over two hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 她的祖先在兩百多年前橫渡台灣海峽移居台南開墾。

examples.en: A detailed genealogical family tree lists all known ancestors dating back centuries.
examples.zh: 這份詳盡完整的家族族譜記載著數個世紀以來所有可考的列祖列宗。

examples.en: Believers worship Mazu at the historical temple for safe voyages.
examples.zh: 信眾在歷史悠久的廟宇虔誠祭拜媽祖祈求出航平安。

examples.en: Millions gather at holy sites across the world to worship peacefully.
examples.zh: 數百萬人在世界各地的神聖聖地平和齊聚，進行崇敬敬拜。

examples.en: Devout villagers worship their guardian Earth God with fruit and sweet sticky rice.
examples.zh: 虔誠的村民備妥新鮮水果與甜米糕，誠心敬奉護佑鄰里的土地公。

examples.en: Worshippers hold burning incense sticks and bow with reverence.
examples.zh: 信徒手持點燃的香枝，恭敬地鞠躬參拜。

examples.en: The soothing aroma of sandalwood incense gently drifted through the meditation hall.
examples.zh: 沉靜舒緩的天然檀香幽幽飄蕩在整座禪修大廳之中。

examples.en: Many temples now promote lighting fewer incense sticks to reduce PM2.5 smoke.
examples.zh: 許多寺廟宮觀現正大力倡導一爐一炷香以減少空氣中的 PM2.5 煙霧。

examples.en: Longshan Temple in Wanhua is a renowned architectural landmark.
examples.zh: 萬華的龍山寺是一座聞名遐邇的宗教古蹟地標。

examples.en: Tourists marveled at the intricate stone dragon pillars carved inside the temple.
examples.zh: 觀光客對寺廟內部雕刻精細入微的石雕龍柱讚嘆不已。

examples.en: Early in the morning, neighborhood residents gather outside the temple courtyard to chat.
examples.zh: 一大清早，社區居民紛紛聚集在廟埕前廣場熱絡寒暄聊天。

examples.en: The vibrant temple fair features lion dances, stilt walkers, and food stalls.
examples.zh: 熱鬧非凡的廟會包含了舞獅、高蹺陣頭與各式小吃攤位。

examples.en: Traditional shadow puppets and open-air glove opera drew cheerful crowds at the temple fair.
examples.zh: 傳統皮影戲與戶外布袋戲外台野台戲在熱鬧廟會中博得滿堂喝采。

examples.en: Children love catching goldfish and buying candied fruits at the annual temple fair.
examples.zh: 小朋友們最愛在一年一度的熱鬧廟會上撈金魚和買甜滋滋的糖葫蘆。

examples.en: The annual Dajia Mazu pilgrimage attracts hundreds of thousands of pilgrims.
examples.zh: 一年一度的大甲媽祖遶境進香吸引了數十萬名隨香信徒。

examples.en: Devotees walk over three hundred kilometers on foot during the nine-day pilgrimage.
examples.zh: 虔誠信眾在為期九天八夜的遶境進香途中，徒步跋涉超過三百公里。

examples.en: Literature lovers made a quiet pilgrimage to Shakespeare’s birthplace in England.
examples.zh: 文學愛好者們專程前往英國莎士比亞的出生故居進行一場靜謐的心靈朝聖。

examples.en: Mazu is revered as the compassionate goddess of the sea.
examples.zh: 媽祖被尊崇為慈悲護佑眾生的海上女神。

examples.en: In Greek mythology, Athena was venerated as the goddess of wisdom and strategic war.
examples.zh: 在希臘神話中，雅典娜被尊奉為掌管智慧與軍事策略的女神。

examples.en: Fisherman offer prayers and thanksgiving whenever they return safely to the goddess's shrine.
examples.zh: 漁民每次平安返港靠岸，總會向女神的神龕敬獻虔誠的祈禱與感恩。

examples.en: Dragon Boat Festival falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.
examples.zh: 端午節是在農曆五月初五這一天。

examples.en: Hanging sweet flag and mugwort on doorways during Dragon Boat Festival wards off bugs.
examples.zh: 端午節期間在門楣上懸掛菖蒲與艾草能驅避蚊蟲毒蛇。

examples.en: Families practice standing fresh raw eggs upright at noon on Dragon Boat Festival.
examples.zh: 各家大小在端午節正午十二點嘗試練習將生雞蛋直立在地面上祈求好運。

examples.en: Rowers paddle vigorously in sync during the exciting dragon boat race.
examples.zh: 划手們在刺激的龍舟競賽中整齊劃一地奮力划槳。

examples.en: The front drummer beats a rhythmic tempo to guide the dragon boat crew.
examples.zh: 船頭的鼓手敲擊出節奏明快的鼓聲以統一步調指揮龍舟隊員。

examples.en: A skilled flag-catcher leans forward over the bow to grab the finish line flag on the dragon boat.
examples.zh: 身手矯捷的奪標手從龍舟龍頭前傾探出，在終點線瞬間奪下勝利旗幟。

examples.en: We wrap savory sticky rice, salted egg yolk, and mushrooms into rice dumplings.
examples.zh: 我們將香濃糯米、鹹蛋黃與香菇包入美味粽子裡。

examples.en: Northern and southern Taiwanese rice dumplings differ in their cooking and steaming techniques.
examples.zh: 台灣北部粽與南部粽在烹煮手法與水煮清蒸技法上各有千秋特色。

examples.en: Fragrant bamboo leaves impart a distinctive earthy aroma to every boiled rice dumpling.
examples.zh: 清香天然的竹葉為每一顆水煮粽子增添了獨特的自然香氣。

examples.en: On Moon Festival, people enjoy outdoor barbecues and gaze at the full moon.
examples.zh: 中秋節時，大家喜歡在戶外烤肉並賞圓月。

examples.en: Moon Festival is also known as Mid-Autumn Festival across Asian communities.
examples.zh: 中秋節在華人社會中又被普遍稱為「仲秋節」或「八月半」。

examples.en: Sharing boxes of gift mooncakes with business associates is customary before Moon Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋佳節前夕，贈送精美月餅禮盒予商業夥伴是十分常見的社交禮數。

examples.en: Sweet red bean paste and salted egg yolks are classic mooncake fillings.
examples.zh: 甜紅豆沙與鹹蛋黃是經典的廣式月餅內餡。

examples.en: Modern bakeries craft innovative snowy mooncakes stuffed with fruit ice cream.
examples.zh: 現代新穎烘焙坊研發出填入香濃水果冰淇淋的創新冰皮月餅。

examples.en: Slice the rich mooncake into small wedges to savor with a pot of hot oolong tea.
examples.zh: 將濃郁紮實的月餅切成小塊，搭配一壺現泡熱烏龍茶細細品嚐最對味。

examples.en: Madou pomelos are sweet, juicy, and popular during autumn.
examples.zh: 麻豆文旦柚酸甜多汁，在中秋時節極受歡迎。

examples.en: Playful children carve the thick green pomelo peel into funny helmets.
examples.zh: 調皮可愛的孩子們常把厚實翠綠的柚子皮剝切雕琢成趣味柚子帽。

examples.en: Fresh pomelo fruit segments provide a rich boost of dietary fiber and vitamin C.
examples.zh: 鮮甜多汁的柚子果肉富含豐富的膳食纖維與天然維他命 C。

examples.en: Having a street-side barbecue with friends has become a Taiwanese Moon Festival tradition.
examples.zh: 與好友在街邊戶外烤肉已成為台灣獨特的中秋習俗。

examples.en: We grilled sweet corn, juicy sausages, and marinated chicken wings on the barbecue grill.
examples.zh: 我們在烤肉架上碳烤甜玉米、多汁香腸以及醃漬入味的美味雞翅。

examples.en: The smoky aroma of evening street barbecues wafted throughout the whole neighborhood alley.
examples.zh: 街坊鄰里傍晚烤肉飄出的陣陣炭烤香氣，瀰漫在整條溫馨小巷弄中。

examples.en: The bright full moon symbolizes family unity and completeness.
examples.zh: 明亮的滿月象徵著家庭團圓與圓滿。

examples.en: Telescopes set up on the mountain ridge gave stargazers crisp views of the full moon craters.
examples.zh: 架設在山脊高處的望遠鏡讓觀星者清晰飽覽滿月表面的環形隕石坑。

examples.en: High ocean tides are strongest during periods of the full moon and new moon.
examples.zh: 海洋大潮在滿月與新月期間的潮位漲落最為顯著強勁。

examples.en: Ghost Festival involves offering bountiful food feasts to wandering spirits.
examples.zh: 中元普渡包含準備豐盛的食物供品以祭祀孤魂好兄弟。

examples.en: During the seventh lunar month, many follow customs related to the Ghost Festival.
examples.zh: 在農曆七月期間，許多人都會遵循中元節相關的各項傳統禁忌習俗。

examples.en: Companies set up long banquet tables outside their lobbies for the annual Ghost Festival puja.
examples.zh: 各大公司行號會在辦公大樓大廳外擺設長條普渡祭拜供桌以祈求營運順遂。

examples.en: We said a silent prayer for our family's health and happiness.
examples.zh: 我們默默祈禱祈求全家平安健康與幸福。

examples.en: Words of comfort and prayers poured in from empathetic citizens following the disaster.
examples.zh: 災害發生之後，富有同理心的廣大公民紛紛送上暖心慰問與真摯禱念。

examples.en: Morning prayer in the temple provided solace and inner tranquility to troubled minds.
examples.zh: 寺院晨間清幽的祈福早課為心煩意亂的信眾提供了莫大的慰藉與心靈平靜。

examples.en: Worshippers pray at the altar for good academic and career luck.
examples.zh: 信眾在神龕前虔誠祈求學業進步與考運亨通。

examples.en: Let us pray together for world peace and an end to armed conflicts.
examples.zh: 讓我們齊心祈禱世界和平，祈願武裝衝突早日劃下休止符。

examples.en: Before boarding the fishing vessel, sailors pray reverently for favorable winds and calm seas.
examples.zh: 登船出海作業前，水手船員們虔誠祈求順風啟航、風平浪靜。

examples.en: We sent our sincere wedding blessings to the lovely newlyweds.
examples.zh: 我們向這對可愛的新人送上最真摯的婚禮祝福。

examples.en: Having a supportive and loving family is truly an invaluable blessing in life.
examples.zh: 擁有一個充滿愛與無私支持的溫暖家庭，無疑是人生中無比珍貴的福份。

examples.en: Monks recited ancient sacred mantras to bestow safety blessings upon travelers.
examples.zh: 僧侶吟誦古老的神聖經文，為遠行跋涉的旅人祈求一路平安順遂。

examples.en: Red symbolizes good fortune and prosperity in Chinese culture.
examples.zh: 在中華文化中，紅色象徵著吉祥好運與繁榮富貴。

examples.en: He amassed an enormous fortune through decades of prudent tech investing.
examples.zh: 憑藉數十年審慎精準的高科技投資，他積累了可觀龐大的財富。

examples.en: It was sheer good fortune that no one was injured during the unexpected road landslide.
examples.zh: 在那場突如其來的山區道路落石坍方中無人受傷，純粹是萬幸的好運氣。

examples.en: Many people try traditional bird divination fortune-telling near Longshan Temple.
examples.zh: 許多人在龍山寺地下街嘗試傳統的鳥卦算命占卜。

examples.en: Purple Star Astrology (Zi Wei Dou Shu) is a popular form of Chinese fortune-telling.
examples.zh: 紫微斗數在華人命理學中是一門廣受歡迎且體系嚴謹的算命占卜術。

examples.en: Some consider fortune-telling mere folklore, while others seek it for guidance.
examples.zh: 有些人將算命占卜純粹視為民俗娛樂，有些人則藉此尋求人生抉擇指引。

examples.en: The fortune teller interpreted the hexagram symbols in the I Ching.
examples.zh: 算命師依據《易經》卦象符號為客人解讀命理。

examples.en: A skilled fortune teller analyzed her birth date and time according to the lunar calendar.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的命理大師依據農曆排盤，細心剖析她的生辰八字與流年大運。

examples.en: Queues formed outside the famous fortune teller's modest booth in the underground market.
examples.zh: 地下街那位名聲響亮的算命大師簡樸攤位前排起了長長的問事隊伍。

examples.en: It is superstitious to avoid the number four just because of sound similarity.
examples.zh: 僅因為諧音關係而避諱數字「四」是屬於迷信想法。

examples.en: He is not superstitious, but he still prefers picking an auspicious wedding date.
examples.zh: 他雖然並不迷信，但依然偏好挑選農民曆上的黃道吉日來舉辦婚禮。

examples.en: Athletes sometimes develop superstitious routines like wearing lucky socks.
examples.zh: 運動員有時會發展出一些帶有迷信色彩的習慣，例如比賽時穿幸運襪。

examples.en: Pointing directly at the moon is an old childhood superstition.
examples.zh: 用手指直接指月亮是小時候聽過的古老民間迷信。

examples.en: Stepping on the raised wooden threshold of a temple doorway violates a classic superstition.
examples.zh: 腳踩寺廟大門口凸起的高聳木門檻，違背了一項傳統民俗禁忌與迷信。

examples.en: Modern scientific education helps dispel irrational fear and ancient superstition.
examples.zh: 現代科學普及教育有助於消除非理性的無端恐懼與陳舊的民間迷信觀念。

examples.en: Gifting clocks or sharp scissors is a traditional cultural taboo.
examples.zh: 送鐘錶或鋒利剪刀在傳統送禮文化中是一大禁忌。

examples.en: Discussing financial debts openly at the dining table is considered taboo in his household.
examples.zh: 在他家中，在餐桌上公開談論個人債務與金錢困境被視為一大禁忌。

examples.en: Wearing all-black apparel to a joyous wedding celebration is an absolute social taboo.
examples.zh: 參加喜氣洋洋的熱鬧婚宴若穿著一身全黑衣著，是極不恰當的社交大忌。

words.definition: 遊行；遶境遊行；列隊行進

examples.en: Thousands joined the colorful annual carnival parade downtown.
examples.zh: 數千人走上街頭參加市中心色彩繽紛的一年一度嘉年華大遊行。

examples.en: High school marching bands and drill teams stepped in unison during the holiday parade.
examples.zh: 高中管樂隊與儀隊在節慶盛大遊行隊伍中邁著整齊劃一的英挺步伐行進。

examples.en: Giant colorful balloons of cartoon characters floated majestically along the parade route.
examples.zh: 巨型卡通玩偶五彩氣球沿著遊行指定路線緩緩飄過，引得觀眾陣陣喝采。

words.definition: 傳統服飾；戲服；化裝舞會服

examples.en: Indigenous dancers wore vibrant, handcrafted traditional tribal costumes.
examples.zh: 原住民舞者身著色彩鮮豔純手工製作的傳統族服。

examples.en: Elementary kids dressed up in superhero and wizard costumes for Halloween.
examples.zh: 國小學童在萬聖節派對上紛紛換上超級英雄與神秘巫師的趣味裝扮。

examples.en: Hand-embroidered silk costumes used in Taiwanese opera are dazzling works of textile art.
examples.zh: 歌仔戲表演所穿著的手工刺繡真絲戲服，是令人賞心悅目的刺繡藝術品。

examples.en: Wearing a medical surgical mask on the MRT is a common habit.
examples.zh: 搭乘捷運時佩戴醫療外科口罩是常見的衛生習慣。

examples.en: Performers at the Venice carnival disguised their identities behind golden masks.
examples.zh: 威尼斯嘉年華會上的化裝表演者紛紛戴上華麗的金色面具隱藏真實身分。

examples.en: A fresh facial clay mask tightens pores and cleanses excess surface skin oil.
examples.zh: 敷上一層新鮮的深層淨膚泥膜能緊緻毛孔並深層清潔肌膚多餘油脂。

examples.en: The Earth God (Tudigong) is a widely venerated local neighborhood deity.
examples.zh: 土地公是深受各地社區街坊鄰里愛戴信奉的在地神祇。

examples.en: Wenchang Dijun is honored as the patron deity of scholarship and national exams.
examples.zh: 文昌帝君被莘莘學子尊奉為庇佑考運亨通與升學金榜題名的守護神祇。

examples.en: Ancient mountain shrines are erected to pay respect to the spiritual forest deity.
examples.zh: 古樸清幽的深山小祠堂旨在表達對守護山林自然山神靈性威嚴的崇敬。

examples.en: Puppet theater (Budaixi) is an invaluable piece of Taiwanese intangible cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 布袋戲是台灣無比珍貴且具代表性的無形文化遺產。

examples.en: Preserving historic fortresses and red-brick streets protects our rich cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 妥善修復與保存歷史古堡與老街紅磚建築，是在守護我們豐富的文化資產。

examples.en: UNESCO designates extraordinary global monuments as protected world cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 聯合國教科文組織將世界上超凡卓絕的歷史古蹟評定列入受保護的世界文化遺產。
